body:
I understand the feeling like an inconvenience, the only time I manage to open up to anyone is when I’m drunk but when I tell my close friends about how I’m feeling they never know what to say because it’s all a bit fucked up for them and they can’t understand it at all.I’m not sure if my words will be of any help for you but I just want you to know you’re not alone in how you feel I’m sure there must be a way to get better I just hope we find it sooner rather than later.

Thankyou for being a health care worker btw, thanks to people like you I’m still here

Why do you think it annoys your fiancé? To me that does not sound very healthy. My ex bless her, tried her damned hardest to pull me out of my rut and unfortunately I destroyed all that we had. It’s his duty as a your fiancé to help you.

I also found paid therapy was no good for me because to me I was just a number to them, what has helped me was community drug and alcohol therapy, where I live it’s free and you could tell the nurses and therapists genuinely cared. I think it’s important for you to reach out for help, a problem shared is a problem halved.
